description: LABELLED SYNTHETIC, source-grounded: the second exec run of one thread (codex exec resume). The thread's first run reported a total of input 1000 (cached 0), output 25. The pinned emitter copies ThreadTokenUsage.total into this run's turn.completed, and the protocol accumulates every response into total_token_usage (TokenUsageInfo::append_last_usage), so 2500 input tokens is the thread's cumulative total; this turn alone used 1500 input tokens, a delta the writer must not compute. A per-turn reading would claim 2500 for this turn with exactly the same numbers. Measurement (0.8.0-prototype): the running total is only a Lower bound (it adds the responses whose usage arrived), and 2500 - 2000 = 500 is the uncached component's conditional value, never the canonical tranche, because the cache-write 0 may be the deserializer default.

lines: {"type":"item.completed","item":{"id":"item_0","type":"agent_message","text":"SYNTHETIC: second turn of a resumed thread."}}

counterexamples.why: Would state that this turn used 500 uncached input tokens; the thread did, over both runs. Equal components, different meaning.
The snapshot includes the earlier run of the resumed thread; it is not this run's consumption, which needs session-resume linkage.
